subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — propose compliance office-hours rotations
messages:
From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@finly.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@finly.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough windows

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. We at Finly are preparing for our vendor review and would like to schedule the following: a joint SOC 2 controls walkthrough, a DPA review with legal, and a short Q&A with your pen-test contact to align scope.

We want to minimize back-and-forth; would Redwood be open to a recurring "compliance office hours" approach (45–90 min blocks) over the week of Sep 13–17 so our teams can drop in? If not, we can book three discrete sessions. Prefer mornings PT.

Attached is our initial controls questionnaire — if you can surface any obvious evidence gaps ahead of time that would help us prep.

Typical attendees: Finly security + legal (Priya), procurement.

Thanks — looking for a few proposed slots and a calendar invite.

Best,
Evan Ross
Head of Security Operations
Finly

Attachments: Finly-Initial-Controls-Questions.xlsx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@finly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough windows

Hi Evan —

Appreciate the context and the questionnaire. Happy to do a recurring office-hours cadence for that week. To keep it efficient I propose the following pattern:

- Mon/Wed/Fri 60-min morning slots (08:30–09:30 PT) for SOC 2 controls review (recorded, notes shared)
- Tue 45-min DPA legal sync (09:30–10:15 PT) — we can have our contracts lead on the call
- Thu 30-min pen-test scope Q&A (08:30–09:00 PT) with our pen vendor liaison

If these work for Finly, I can send a recurring calendar invite (Google calendar) with Zoom links and an agenda template. We can also limit the attendee list for specific sessions (legal only for DPA).

Cc'ing Ben and Marissa — Ben will handle contract/offer questions and credits if any, Marissa will run the SOC 2 evidence mapping and the pen-test liaison.

I pulled the questionnaire — attaching a short evidence mapping CSV and a DPA draft for Priya to scan before the DPA session.

Proposed attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft-v2.pdf, SOC2-evidence-mapping.csv

Next step: Evan, tell me which single day works to start the recurring series (Mon 13 or Tue 14?), and Priya / your legal can flag any deal stoppers up front.

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft-v2.pdf; SOC2-evidence-mapping.csv

Subject: Internal: Finly office-hours rotation + roles

Team — quick internal plan so we present a tight experience:

- Monday (SOC 2): Marissa leads evidence walkthrough; bring access controls exports and retention overview.
- Tuesday (DPA): Ben join for commercial/terms; I will cover security controls mapping. Have the DPA redlines ready.
- Thursday (Pen-test): Vivek to own pen vendor intro + scope delimitation (15–20 min pre-brief with vendor).

Please prepare the following artifacts by Sep 9:
- Marissa: control evidence list (GCS links + short notes).
- Ben: DPA clause notes + fallback language for procurement.
- Vivek: vendor contact + short scope statement.

We should use the recurring "office hours" calendar invite so Finly can drop in; I will only invite the minimal set and expand as needed. If any of these dates conflict with on-call schedules, flag now.

Thanks — Sofia
